before: ## Buying commercial bar fridges and trade refrigeration online
insert:
## A simple decision rule

If the fridge is opened more than a few times an hour, runs for long hours or sits in a warm room, buy a commercial unit. If it serves a small household in a cool room, a domestic model is usually enough. When the use sits between the two, choose the more robust option, because it is cheaper to buy the right fridge once than to replace the wrong one.
